name: dtc-checker
description: Onboard diagnostic trouble code reader: view and clear DTCs from the GEM in one 20-row screen, read through the V850 IOC (DSI namespace 2).
author: dspl1236
screens: ToolkitDTC.esd - DTC overview (20 rows), detail with status flags, clear/test
notes: GEM screen only: the builder copies engdefs/ToolkitDTC.esd to /mnt/efs-system/engdefs. No scripts.
